description: An unset.sh profile: the side column of the page at unset.sh/@handle and the order of its cards. One per account. Kept minimal (ADR 0051): anything richer lives in sh.unset.section cards.

main.description: The account's unset.sh profile. Absent means the account has no published unset.sh profile.

displayName.description: Name shown at the top of the profile.

avatarShape.description: How the avatar is cropped. Absent or unknown means round.

location.description: Free-text place, as the member writes it.

website.description: The member's website: an http or https URL. A reader drops any other scheme.

visibility.description: Who unset.sh shows the page to: public (everyone), signedIn (people signed in to unset.sh), ownerOnly (only the account itself; others see that the account exists and nothing more). Absent means public; an unknown value is read as ownerOnly. A request to apps, not access control: the record stays readable by anyone on the network.

listed.description: True: listed in the unset.sh directory. Absent or false: not listed; the page is still public at its URL.

cards.description: Record keys of this account's sh.unset.section records, in page order. A key with no record is skipped; a record not listed shows after the listed ones, oldest first.

createdAt.description: When the profile was first published.
